artefact: the complementary ERA5 vorticity segment needed to test east-edge support without replacing the acquired T4E.18 record
declared_by: Edward Jonathan Bentley, maintainer (scientific choice); drafted by GitHub Copilot at the maintainer's direction and NOT VALID until the maintainer has reviewed and adopted it

why_this_exists.diagnostic: T4E.35 found that the four largest finite raw-field join errors and the sole no-feature row are all nearest the existing crop's east edge. The raw-field median nearest-feature error is 1617.7 km for the seven rows within two degrees of any edge and 35.9 km for the eleven interior rows.
why_this_exists.limitation: Those rows had already been inspected, RUBY is an east-edge counterexample, and the association is post-hoc. T4E.35 therefore selects this experiment but supplies neither its acceptance nor evidence that truncation caused an error.
why_this_exists.question: Does adding the missing eastward support, while holding the population, variable, extraction and catalogue tolerance fixed, make the raw-field catalogue join meet the already declared T4E.18 usability gates?

wrapped_geometry.seam_rule: The 180E and -180 coordinates describe one meridian. Verify their values agree within the source encoding tolerance, retain it once, and refuse a mismatch; ordinary concatenation would duplicate one column and misstate the geometry.
wrapped_geometry.the_parent_record_must_remain: The 140E..180E T4E.18 record remains byte-for-byte unchanged and separately addressable. The complementary segment is a second content-addressed acquisition, never a replacement or in-place extension.

frozen_population.source: the same 18 deepest-interior per-storm observations recorded by T4E.28
frozen_population.selection: Do not rerun the catalogue census over the wider longitude range and do not admit new storms. The experiment changes spatial field support around the already selected storm-times, not the evaluation population.
frozen_population.counterexample_retained: RUBY is one degree from the east edge but has a 67.6 km raw-field error. It remains in the population and prevents east-edge position from being treated as sufficient by definition.

frozen_extraction.sign: Negate southern-hemisphere relative vorticity before extraction.
frozen_extraction.diagnostic_path: swt_planes: wavelet 'db2', level 3, all extractable planes pooled
frozen_extraction.forbidden_changes: No extractor, null, alpha, seed, wavelet, level, tolerance, catalogue row or population change belongs in this experiment.

gate_declared_before_acquisition.operational_gate: The complementary request must complete all 48 integrity-checked monthly shards and exactly 5844 timestamps. The wrapped seam must pass the declared coordinate and value check before any extraction runs.
gate_declared_before_acquisition.primary_scientific_path: raw_field, fixed because T4E.28 reproduced it as the lower-error direct representation before this declaration existed
gate_declared_before_acquisition.condition_1: At least 9 of the fixed 18 storms have one or more raw-field features inside their own catalogue radius.
gate_declared_before_acquisition.condition_2: At least 9 of the fixed 18 storms have three or more raw-field features inside their own catalogue radius.
gate_declared_before_acquisition.decision: PASS requires both conditions. Otherwise the result is FAIL if all declared inputs and rows are measurable, or INVALID/REFUSED with the missing support named. SWT-plane counts cannot rescue a raw-field failure.
gate_declared_before_acquisition.falsification: Failure of either unchanged 9-of-18 gate falsifies added eastward support as a sufficient repair for the acquired-record identity blocker under this extraction procedure. It does not establish that crop support contributes nothing.
gate_declared_before_acquisition.paired_diagnostics: Report old and widened feature count, full sorted distance list, nearest distance and inside-radius count for every storm, with the five named east-edge stress rows and RUBY visible. These diagnostics explain the verdict but select no new threshold.

governing_rules: Planning and validation are offline. Acquisition requires a separate explicit network authorisation after this declaration is reviewed and adopted.
Code does not adopt a scientific declaration for a person.
The 2022-2023 forecast-test period remains unacquired and unopened.
PASS, FAIL, INVALID and REFUSED remain distinct terminal meanings.
claim_boundary: A PASS would establish only that added eastward support makes the fixed raw-field join usable under the inherited gate on these 18 development-period storms. It would not establish crop truncation as the cause, approve a mining radius, demonstrate kind recurrence, open forecast-test data or make a claim about the atmosphere.
